title: Comparison of variations in cornea after one-handed and two-handed coaxial phacoemulsification

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license> and ali:license_ref https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/3.0/, Dove Medical Press terms); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Age-related cataract with LOCS III nuclear opalescence of grade 3 or less, normal anterior segment and fundus, no previous intraocular surgery or injury; other cataract types and corneal opacities excluded

groups.description: One-handed coaxial phacoemulsification through a single 2.4 mm clear corneal incision at 135 degrees (Verion-guided), Centurion OZil IP, monofocal IOL in the bag; technique chosen by the patient; single surgeon; prospective non-randomized; 100 eyes of 93 patients
Two-handed coaxial phacoemulsification through a 2.4 mm main incision plus a 1.0 mm side port with a manual chopper; eye conditions matched; 100 eyes of 91 patients

series.baseline_label: Preop (Table 4, ECD (/mm2) block) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 4 'One-handed Mean ± SD' column, rows Preop, 1 week, 1 month and 3 month postop under 'ECD (/mm2)'; 1 week = 7/30.4375 months; central ECD by Tomey EM-3000 non-contact specular microscopy. Per-visit n not tabulated.

series.baseline_label: Preop (Table 4, ECD (/mm2) block) = preoperative central ECD of the operated eye
series.notes: Table 4 'Two-handed Mean ± SD' column, rows Preop, 1 week, 1 month and 3 month postop under 'ECD (/mm2)'; 1 week = 7/30.4375 months. Per-visit n not tabulated.

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for each group; the absolute ECD series is used

exclusions.what: Table 4 P-value columns; CV, CCT, HEX% and average cell size blocks
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible; not endothelial cell density

notes: Role: two standard phacoemulsification techniques compared without an investigational agent or device; both control-role, separate groups.
Exclusion criteria included failure to attend postoperative appointments.
Same institution and surgeon as ecd-pmc6766098 (steep-axis variant), with a different enrolment period (August 2016 to September 2017 here).
